oh-county-officials.summary: The County card names the commissioners of 83 counties and the county executives of Cuyahoga and Summit. It names no commissioner in Ashland, Holmes or Lawrence, and no county's other elected officers.
oh-county-officials.why: Ashland's website had an expired certificate, Holmes's answers with a captcha, and no Lawrence County website naming its commissioners was found. No list of the other county officers has been read.
oh-county-officials.wanted: The commissioners of Ashland, Holmes and Lawrence from each county, and a statewide list of every county's other elected officers.

oh-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Village card names the place you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
oh-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Ohio's cities and villages has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
oh-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's and village's mayor and council members, or a place's own published list of them.

oh-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its board of education.
oh-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Ohio's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
oh-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

oh-townships.summary: The Township or City card draws Ohio's townships and says which have a government of its own, and does not name their trustees and fiscal officers.
oh-townships.why: No list of the people each township elects has been read for this app yet.
oh-townships.wanted: A statewide list of each township's trustees and fiscal officer, or a township's own published list of them.
